_comment: Project-scope MCP servers. This file is COMMITTED to the repo, which is the
only way MCP servers reach a cloud session — user-scope servers added with
`claude mcp add` live in ~/.claude.json on your machine and never travel.
${VAR} expands from the environment at load time, so the tokens come from the
cloud environment's variables (or your local shell) and never get committed.
These servers dial out from inside the session VM, so their hosts must be in
the environment's allowed-domains list. See ALLOWED-DOMAINS.txt.
Delete this _comment key before committing if you want strict JSON hygiene;
Claude Code ignores unknown top-level keys either way.
WINDOWS CAVEAT on the playwright entry: your user-scope config launches it as
`cmd /c npx ...` because bare `npx` can fail to resolve on Windows. This file
is shared with Linux cloud sessions where `cmd` does not exist, so it uses bare
`npx`. If playwright fails to start locally, delete the entry here — your
user-scope server in ~/.claude.json already covers local sessions, and project
scope only needs to carry it for the cloud.
